dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_DATA_SOURCE: Select 'Record Containing JSON Data' to render data from a single JSON record within the module. Select 'Get Live Data' to enable selection of module and fields, rendering real-time data based on specified filters
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_LEVEL_COUNT: Select the picklist to group the records in the selected module.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_LIVE_DATA: It allows you to select a module and fields, rendering real-time data.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_RESOURCE: Select the module whose records are to be visualize.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_SELECT_JSON_FIELD: Select the Field which has the data, only json type fields will be available in the dropdown.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_STATIC_DATA: It allows you to select a single JSON record within the module.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_WORD_SOURCE: Select a picklist or text field as the source for generating the word cloud. The chosen field's data will determine the word size.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_X_AXIS: Choose a picklist or datetime field to represent the X-Axis values in the Heatmap visualization.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_Y_AXIS: Choose a picklist or datetime field to represent the Y-Axis values in the Heatmap visualization.
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_X_Y_AXIS_DATE_FORMAT: Select the format for displaying dates. Choose 'Month Year' (e.g., Jan 2025) or 'Month Day' (e.g., Jan 15).
dataVisualization.TOOLTIP_X_Y_AXIS_DATE_RANGE: Choose 'Monthly' to group data by month or 'Daily' for a day-wise breakdown.
